summary.text: Eric Albus is a Republican state representative from Montana House District 28 who is running for Montana State Senate District 14 on November 3, 2026, and is not seeking re-election to the House.
A rancher, outfitter and dryland farmer, he took office in the House in January 2025 and sits on the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Eric Albus' career experience includes working as a rancher, outfitter and dryland farmer.
In 2022, Gov. Greg Gianforte appointed him to the Private Land/Public Wildlife Advisory Committee at the Montana Department of Fish, Wildlife & Parks.
Albus took office in the Montana House in January 2025 and in the 2025-2026 session was assigned to the Appropriations Committee.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary for State Senate District 14 and faces Democrat Blake Borst in the general election, in a race with no incumbent.
